svg.aria-label: The Library page on a 390px-wide phone: under the search box the six filter chips, All, Movies, TV, Anime, Kept and Stale, sit in two even rows of three, with the sort menu and the first title of the list below.
svg.text: Library filter chips now sit in an even grid on phones
The Library page on a 390px-wide phone, as built
Filters in two even rows of three
Before: Stale sat alone on its own row
From 460px wide, all six fit on one row
